Throughout our discussions, it became clear that preserving civilian control and ensuring that any transition of leadership respects the rule of law and the wishes of the populace is crucial for maintaining true democratic principles. Any involvement of the military must adhere strictly to legal frameworks and avoid undermining the fundamental freedoms and rights protected under a democratic system.
agreement_level:
Probably disagree

After discussing the matter thoroughly with several individuals who largely shared similar sentiments—that democratic principles dictate civilian control rather than military intervention—I find myself holding firmly yet slightly softened towards the stance against military takeovers even under governmental failure scenarios due to consistent reasoning regarding the preservation of democratic processes and constitutional order. However, given our conversations also highlighted potential complexities around ensuring legitimate transitions led by civilians, "probably disagree" best encapsulates my evolved position.
